inputs.text: [excited] Tar… boh… saurus. [curious] "Tarbo," in Greek, means fear, dread — the one who makes everyone tremble. And "saurus" means lizard.
[proud] The lizard who brings fear, I got that one right away.
[happily] Perfect. [confident] It was T. rex's cousin, in Asia, [amazed] in the Gobi Desert, seventy million years ago.
[curious] Did it really look like T. rex?
[playful] A lot. [confident] Same family of hunters, just the Mongolia version.
